text.p: Country Maid Foods Inc said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of the commercial egg-breaking facility from Villines Foods Inc.
"This acquisition should increase revenues by approximately $30 million on an annual basis," Country Maid President John Moneymaker said in a statement.

The plant, located in northwest Arkansas, allows Country Maid to utilize its own production in value-added egg production. The facility produces liquid eggs, frozen egg products and value-added products used in food product manufacturing, food service and further processing.
The egg-breaking plant has the capacity of processing 1.2 million dozen eggs per week.
